baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative أَضَلُّوا and the closing noun ضَلَالًا bracket كَثِيرًا and the restrictive increase formula وَلَا تَزِدِ ... إِلَّا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The agents scale departure from right aim across a multitude; the prayer then turns the same scaling logic inward, allowing every added increment to reinforce only the wrongdoers' own loss of direction.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance and aim supplies both the outward causation and the inward state, closing the feedback loop.
Numerical abundance makes the first half a scaling event rather than an isolated error.
Growth or added increment functions as the operator redirected onto the misleaders themselves.
Concrete misplacement sharpens wrongdoing as putting action outside its proper place, which answers in further misdirection.

changed_reading.before: They misled many, followed by a prayer that the wrongdoers become more misguided.
changed_reading.after: Those who multiply others' departure enter a self-reinforcing consequence: each further increment consolidates their own loss of aim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The grievance-bearing branch of ظَّالِمِينَ stands inside a negative-exceptive request governing تَزِدِ and ضَلَالًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The second clause can function as a tightly delimited petition for redress: no added share is to accrue to the wrongdoers except further loss of what they claimed to control or direct.

activation_trace.role: Grievance and the demand for redress give the prayer the posture of a claim against wrongdoers.
Seeking or bidding for more supplies an allocation contest that the negative request shuts down.
Loss and failure to locate something make ضَلَالًا the sole debit permitted to accrue.
Abundance of claims or demands turns the many affected people into the weight behind the grievance.

changed_reading.before: The clause is an unrestricted curse for more error.
changed_reading.after: The clause is a counter-allocation in a redress petition: the wrongdoers gain no further share except compounded loss.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's hiddenness and failed-retention branches of ض ل ل remain attached to both أَضَلُّوا and ضَلَالًا, while كَثِيرًا and تَزِدِ supply aggregation and growth.
baseline_models.mechanism: Misleading can be carried as making people unavailable to guidance or unfindable within a growing mass. Wrongdoing withholds access to what is due, and its only increase is deeper disappearance and failure of retention.

activation_trace.role: Hiddenness or absorption recasts path error as loss of visibility and availability.
Loss of retention adds a cognitive mode in which guidance slips out of keeping.
Clustering together supplies the mass in which distinct persons or directions can become obscured.
Growth makes occlusion cumulative rather than static.
Withholding from a right supplies the social action by which access to guidance is blocked.

changed_reading.before: Many people are induced to hold a wrong belief.
changed_reading.after: Many are rendered progressively inaccessible to guidance, while the agents' own capacity to retain or locate the way also disappears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier offer joins protective forgiveness to postponement until a fixed term. Against that offer, the focus request can make added time itself conditional: once reprieve is refused, further duration yields no growth except deeper departure.

activation_trace.role: Covering sin and protecting its bearer supplies the remedial opening paired with delay.
Postponement to a later time makes duration an offered resource whose extension can end.
A fixed temporal limit prevents increase from being imagined as indefinite neutral delay.
Added increment lets the focus prayer operate on remaining duration as well as degree.
Departure from right aim is the sole return produced by the added interval.

structural_cues: 71:4 pairs forgiveness with delay, repeats the delay verb, and closes it at an appointed term before 71:24 restricts increase to one result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remedy, postponement, a fixed term, and later increase; I infer that continued time can feed entrenchment. A live alternative is that تَزِدِ concerns only intensity of state, not lifespan or reprieve.

changed_reading.before: The prayer asks for a greater degree of misguidance.
changed_reading.after: The prayer also asks that any remaining extension of time cease to be neutral reprieve and produce only the exposure of a chosen, deepening course.

context_deltas.mechanism: A call reaches the organ of hearing, but deliberate covering and bound resolve interrupt reception. The focus's causative misguidance therefore becomes reproducible social technique: leaders scale the same blockade that their community repeatedly performs.

activation_trace.role: Calling and drawing by speech supplies the incoming signal that the blockade acts upon.
Listening and accepting what is heard identify the precise reception function being refused.
A covering laid over something turns refusal into active occlusion rather than mere absence of information.
Firm resolve binds the sensory blockade into a maintained disposition.
Hiddenness makes the result of blocked reception an increasing inaccessibility to guidance.
Withholding from a right assigns the blockade its unjust social function.

structural_cues: 71:5-9 varies the call across night, day, public declaration, and secrecy, while 71:7 concentrates the counter-actions in ears, garments, insistence, and arrogance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, receptive ear, covering, and insistence; I infer a causal chain in which reception-blocking is copied and produces mass deviation. Alternatively these gestures may only display a deviation already complete.

changed_reading.before: The leaders persuade many people toward an erroneous proposition.
changed_reading.after: The leaders reproduce a durable reception blockade, making many people unavailable to the call and thereby scaling hiddenness as well as wrong direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following attaches a population to a figure whose wealth and offspring grow yet yield only loss. The focus's كَثِيرًا is thus not only a victim count: capital, descent, and loyal succession form infrastructure that multiplies the reach of misguidance.

activation_trace.role: Loyal succession and following provide the transmission link from an enriched leader to a wider group.
The exact increase operation already converts apparent growth into a single adverse result.
Accumulated wealth supplies material capacity and status for scaling influence.
Descendants extend the multiplier through kinship and continuity.
General diminution exposes the adverse output hidden inside material and familial increase.
Outnumbering through wealth, number, or status supplies the competitive scale of كَثِيرًا.
Loss makes the network's apparent accumulation resolve into persons and value going unaccounted for.

structural_cues: The formula لَمْ يَزِدْهُ ... إِلَّا خَسَارًا in 71:21 anticipates وَلَا تَزِدِ ... إِلَّا ضَلَالًا in 71:24 while the intervening ayat name following and an enormous plot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, increase, wealth, offspring, and loss; I infer that assets and lineage transmit influence rather than merely accompany it. They may instead be only objects of false confidence, with no causal role in misleading others.

changed_reading.before: Many means a large number of separately persuaded people.
changed_reading.after: Many is the output of a scalable patronage and lineage network whose apparent increase already carries loss inside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans pass through stages, grow from the earth, and receive broad traversable ways. In that setting ضَلَالًا becomes a failure to use a deliberately navigable order, while the packet-approved non-dominant ز و د branch lets تَزِدِ suggest that no transition provision remains except path-loss itself.

activation_trace.role: Successive stages turn human existence into a passage through changing conditions.
Human growth and nurture give that passage an organic origin and development.
Penetrating and proceeding along a route supplies the intended human action.
An extended path supplies an available course rather than an absent way.
A wide open pass makes the offered navigability spatially emphatic.
Departure from the path converts created navigability into accountable misrouting.
The split-root image of carrying provision through a transition supplies the exploratory journey mechanism.
Putting something in a wrong concrete place makes the moral failure legible as spatial misuse.

structural_cues: 71:14-20 moves from stages and terrestrial growth to a spread earth explicitly purposed for traversing broad ways.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stages, growth, open routes, and a split focus branch for journey provision; I infer one lifecycle itinerary whose provision can be corrupted. The creation sequence may instead be evidentiary description without a journey arrow.

changed_reading.before: Misguidance is primarily assent to error.
changed_reading.after: Misguidance is also failed traversal of a route-rich created order, with the wrongdoers carrying forward no added provision except further pathlessness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated prohibition on abandoning named gods couples preservation with the love branch carried by Wadd and explicit idol branches. The misleaders maintain deviation by turning attachment to inherited names and objects into a command not to exit.

activation_trace.role: Leaving or abandoning supplies the exit that the repeated commands explicitly forbid.
Love and attachment supply the affective force that can make non-abandonment durable.
The explicit idol branch keeps the affective activation tied to the named object in the ayah.
A second explicit idol branch shows that the preservation campaign extends across the named list.
Departure from right aim is produced by preventing adherents from leaving the attachment system.
Withholding from a right gives the preservation command its coercive effect on followers.

structural_cues: 71:23 repeats لَا تَذَرُنَّ, expands into a list of named gods, and is followed immediately by the focus's causative أَضَلُّوا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated non-abandonment plus love and idol branches for a named item; I infer affective attachment as the campaign's causal glue. A live alternative is that the proper name Wadd is merely referential and does not activate love here.

changed_reading.before: The many are misled by claims about which gods exist.
changed_reading.after: The many are held in deviation by an organized refusal to abandon cherished inherited objects and names; attachment itself becomes transmission machinery.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sent abundance and connected extension first describe rain and increase, but after the focus the sequence contracts into engulfment, entry, and fire. The focus's increase in ضَلَال can therefore operate as a hinge where expansive benefaction reverses into a terminal sink.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release initiate the downward movement of the offered abundance.
Copious outflow from a source gives the earlier water movement its expansive force.
A connected addition that sustains another supplies the positive form of increase later reversed.
Engulfing comprehensively converts abundant medium into an inescapable sink.
Entry into an interior carries the sequence from submersion into a second containment.
Kindled fire identifies the second medium entered after engulfment.
Disappearance and absorption give ضَلَالًا the topology of sinking from availability.
Growth links the earlier extensions to the later adverse accumulation.

structural_cues: 71:11-12 present rain, extension, gardens, and rivers before the focus, while 71:25 immediately follows it with engulfment and entry into fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, abundant flow, connected extension, engulfment, entry, and fire; I infer that the focus marks a reversal from expansion to sink. The later judgment may instead follow without extending ضَلَال into a material topology.

changed_reading.before: Increase in misguidance is an inward intensification with no spatial consequence.
changed_reading.after: Increase in misguidance becomes the reversal point at which offered expansion closes into progressive absorption, containment, and loss of every exit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later conditional joins leaving the group in place to their misleading servants and producing a next generation characterized by rupture and concealment of truth. This turns كَثِيرًا into a recursive output: social instruction and birth can renew the same deviation beyond the present cohort.

activation_trace.role: The repeated causative departure explicitly carries the focus mechanism into the projected future.
Submissive service identifies the population whose orientation is at stake.
The event of birth supplies literal cohort renewal rather than only metaphorical spread.
Departure from right and rupture of a covering characterize the generated continuation as transgressive.
Concealing the truth supplies the epistemic closure reproduced in the next cohort.
Numerical increase now includes recurring cohorts, not only a present crowd.
Increase becomes the contested operator that either propagates outward or folds back onto the agents.

structural_cues: 71:27 repeats the focus's causative root inside an if-left-in-place prediction and immediately coordinates misleading with giving birth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conditional link among being left, misleading, servants, and birth; I infer one reproducing social-generational loop. The birth clause may instead predict offspring character without claiming that pedagogy and lineage are one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: كَثِيرًا counts the many already misled.
changed_reading.after: كَثِيرًا includes a potentially self-renewing future population, so the prayer confines increase to the misleaders rather than letting their deviation keep reproducing outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final ayah repeats the focus's negative-exceptive request with the same increase verb and wrongdoer class, replacing only the complement with breaking and annulment. This lets accumulated path-loss and terminal unmaking coexist as successive dimensions of redress.

activation_trace.role: Repeated increase preserves the same accumulation operator across both prayers.
The repeated wrongdoer class keeps both requests inside one grievance and redress frame.
Destruction, annulment, and breaking supply the terminal complement in the repeated frame.
The focus occurrence establishes the first use of the shared accumulation operator.
The focus grievance branch anchors the first request to the same claim for redress.
Loss supplies the internal and directional process that can precede terminal breaking without being collapsed into it.

structural_cues: 71:24 and 71:28 share وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا and change only the final complement from ضَلَالًا to تَبَارًا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact repeated frame and a final breaking branch; I infer a process-to-endpoint arrow from path-loss to unmaking. The two complements may instead name coordinated but non-sequential petitions.

changed_reading.before: The two verses independently request more misguidance and more destruction.
changed_reading.after: The focus names accumulating internal and directional loss, while the repeated final frame names its possible terminal unmaking; neither dimension erases the other.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch-distant dust image of ك ث ر rather than ordinary numerical abundance. It remains anchored in كَثِيرًا, the hiddenness branch of ض ل ل, and the growth verb تَزِدِ; downstream prose should label it a material analogy for reduced visibility, not a lexical translation of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَثِيرًا can activate roiling abundant dust, while both focus occurrences of ض ل ل can activate disappearance and تَزِدِ makes the condition intensify.

activation_trace.role: A rising mass of abundant dust supplies a material image in which greater quantity destroys visibility.
Hiddenness supplies the perceptual consequence of the roiling mass.
Increase makes the obscuring cloud thicken through its own expansion.

changed_reading.before: A larger number simply means a larger successful audience for the misleaders.
changed_reading.after: The multitude can also be imagined as an obscuring density: its very growth reduces shared visibility of the way.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the obscure spreading-tree branch of ظ ل م and the stray-animal branch of ض ل ل. It remains anchored in focus roots and is reinforced by the packet's human growth and entwined vegetation images; downstream prose should present it only as an ecological systems analogy, never as the direct sense of ظَّالِمِينَ or ضَلَالًا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines growth and clustering with a ظ ل م branch whose shoots exceed their base and a ض ل ل branch of a stray left in a place of loss.

activation_trace.role: Shoots spreading beyond their base supply an image of wrongdoing as overreaching growth.
Clustering together turns isolated overreach into a dense system.
A stray animal left in a wasteland supplies the living result produced beyond the system's proper bounds.
Growth emerging from earth gives the ecological analogy a visible context source.
Entwined and thrusting vegetation supplies the dense growth pattern that can overrun orientation.

changed_reading.before: Wrongdoers cause discrete people to choose the wrong route.
changed_reading.after: Wrongdoing can be modeled as overreaching growth that produces a dense ecology of loss, leaving more lives stranded beyond a proper course.

strongest_changes: The repeated increase-only formulas turn the focus from a static curse into a feedback system in which outward scaling folds back as inward loss.
The ear, covering, and insistence sequence makes misguidance an engineered reception blockade rather than only false persuasion.
Wealth, following, offspring, and the 71:27 conditional make كَثِيرًا the output of social and intergenerational multipliers.
The exact 71:28 parallel preserves path-loss as a process while adding breaking and annulment as a possible endpoint.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates four quantitative and directional levers: causative straying, multitude, increase, and a restrictive exception. Context repeatedly reuses those levers across time, assets, routes, generations, and judgment, while the split ز ي د mapping preserves an exploratory transition-provision reading without forcing it into the stronger models.
remaining_uncertainties: The temporal arrow from refused reprieve to entrenchment is inferred rather than grammatically stated in the focus.
The Wadd-love activation may be dormant in a proper name even though both branches are packet-backed.
The non-dominant ز و د provision image is form-distant and should remain exploratory.
Hiddenness, dust, and ecological growth may be productive analogies without being intended lexical senses in this occurrence.
